messages.subject: multiple plot in one?
parts:
Dears,

I want to put multiple plots in one page. Here's my codes:

###

x<-1:10
y<-rnorm(10)
df<-data.frame(x=x,y=y)

plots<-list()
for(i in 1:4){
gg<-qplot(x,y,df)
plots<-c(plots,list(gg))
}

library(gridExtra)

##now I can do like this:

grid.arrange(plots[[1]],plots[[2]],plots[[3]],plots[[4]],ncol=2)

##but this does not work:

grid.arrange(plots,ncol=2)

Can anyone tell me what's the matter and any solutions?

Tks!

messages.author: a3c668b849637905
messages.subject: Re: multiple plot in one?
parts:
Hi,

see the example in ?grid.arrange

do.call(grid.arrange, c(plots, ncol=2))

HTH,

b.
